fields.body_md:
## About this programme

The Full-time MBA (Master of Business Administration) is taught by Alliance Manchester Business School at the University of Manchester. It is a full-time programme of 15 or 18 months, and you choose the route. It starts in September 2027, is taught in English, and runs on the Manchester city campus.

The school is triple accredited by AMBA, AACSB and EQUIS. Each class typically has 100 students from 30 nationalities.

The most important point for you: you need at least three years of work experience after your degree.

## What you need to get in

**Your degree.** The school normally looks for an upper second-class (2:1) honours result in the UK system. Contact the recruitment team if you are not sure how your Indian degree will be assessed.

**Work experience.** You need at least three years of work after your degree. Your career should show strong, steady progress.

**An admissions test.** You need one of these three tests:

- **MAT** (Manchester Admissions Test), the university's own test.
- **GMAT** (Graduate Management Admission Test). GMAT Superscores are considered.
- **GRE** (Graduate Record Examination).

**English.** You need an overall **IELTS** (International English Language Testing System) score of **6.5**. You also need at least **6.5** in speaking and writing, and at least **6.0** in reading and listening.

Other tests the school accepts:

- **TOEFL iBT:** 90 overall, with 22 in speaking and writing and 20 in reading and listening.
- **PTE Academic:** 59, with 59 in each part.
- **Cambridge CAE** 176, or **CPE**.
- **LanguageCert ESOL SELT B2** 156 (UKVI version).
- **Indian Standard XII English:** 80% (CBSE or CISCE).

At-home or online test versions are not accepted.

**Interview.** Some applicants are invited to an interview. It is Stage 3 of the process, and it is by invitation only.

## What it costs

The tuition fee is **£51,500**. This is the fee for the whole programme, whether you take 15 or 18 months to finish.

**Deposit.** Manchester asks for a deposit of at least **£2,500** before it issues your CAS. A deposit is an upfront payment you make before your course. The CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the document a university issues so you can apply for a UK student visa. The £2,500 deposit is a general postgraduate rule that does not name the MBA. The school takes the deposit off your fees when you register.

**Application fee.** The programme has no application fee.

**Visa money.** For a UK student visa you must show you can pay for your living costs. Manchester is outside London, so you must show **£1,171** for each month of your course, for up to **9 months**. That is **£10,539**. You must have this money for **28 days in a row**. The last day of those 28 days must fall within **31 days** of the day you apply. You show this money to the government. You do not pay it to the university.

**Visa fee.** The Student visa application fee from outside the UK is **£558**.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge is **£776 for each year** of your visa.

### First-year cost example

| Item | How it is worked out | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Tuition | Whole programme fee | £51,500 |
| Visa living money | £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Visa application fee | Fee from outside the UK | £558 |
| Health surcharge | £776 for each year of your visa | £776 or more |
| **Total** | £51,500 + £10,539 + £558 + £776 | **at least £63,373** |

This is a first-year example, not a full budget.

Your visa lasts longer than your course, so you usually pay for more than one year. A 16-month visa costs £1,164: £776, plus half of £776 (£388).

Read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide) for the visa rules. For a wider view, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

**Manchester Bee scholarships.** These MBA awards range from **£5,150** to **£25,750**. Each one suits a different profile. Bee Global, for example, is for applicants from under-represented regions, and Bee Empowered is for female applicants. You can hold only one award. The awards are open in all admissions rounds.

**Named scholarships.** The school also lists other MBA scholarships, including the Forte Foundation Fellowship Scholarships for Women and the Joseph Wright Scholarships.

**Alumni discount.** Graduates of The University of Manchester or UMIST get **20%** off the tuition fees they pay themselves.

For the full details, see the [fees and funding page](https://www.alliancembs.manchester.ac.uk/study/mba/full-time-mba/fees-funding/).

## Deadlines and intakes

The programme starts in **September 2027**. Applications go in through staged rounds. Each round closes at 17:00 UK time. The first two rounds have closed.

| Round | Application deadline |
|---|---|
| 3 | 1 December 2026 |
| 4 | 4 January 2027 |
| 5 | 1 February 2027 |
| 6 | 1 March 2027 |
| 7 | 1 April 2027 |
| 8 | **9 May 2027** |

Round 9 (1 July 2027) is for UK candidates and candidates who do not need a UK student visa, so it is not for you.

Apply early. You can apply for a UK student visa up to **6 months** before your course starts. Government guidance says a decision usually takes **3 weeks** if you apply from outside the UK. Pay the deposit early, because your CAS comes after it.

## How to apply

1. **Prepare your documents.** Gather your CV, and your degree transcripts and certificates in PDF.
2. **Take your admissions test.** Choose MAT, GMAT or GRE, and send the report with your application.
3. **Take your English test.** Your report must meet the scores listed above.
4. **Write your essays.** You need an admission essay and the MBA application essays.
5. **Apply through the University of Manchester Application Portal.** There is no application fee.
6. **Ask for at least one reference.** Your referee completes an online reference form.
7. **Complete the scholarship video, if you apply for an award.** You have **7 days** from receiving the email to finish it.
8. **Attend an interview if you are invited.** Interviews are by invitation only.

## After the programme

The five core courses are:

- Leading Global Transitions
- Leading People and Organisations
- Business Accounting and Finance
- Strategy and Innovation
- Operationalising and Communicating Value

You can choose electives, including Big Data Analytics, Digital Marketing Strategy, Negotiation Skills, and Venture Capital and Private Equity. International electives run at five global centres.

You also complete three real-world consultancy projects. An optional **10-12 week** internship is available, and there is an overseas study tour.

The school says its graduates work in consulting, tech, finance, the NHS and pharma.

The Graduate Route lets you work in the UK after you finish. If you apply on or before 31 December 2026, the visa lasts **2 years**. If you apply on or after 1 January 2027, it lasts **18 months**. The application fee is **£937**. Check the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide) for the rules.

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if:**

- You have at least three years of work experience after your degree, with steady progress.
- You can reach IELTS **6.5** overall, with **6.5** in speaking and writing.
- You can pay the first-year costs above, or you win a Bee scholarship or qualify for the alumni discount.

**Think carefully if:**

- You have less than three years of work experience.
- You cannot apply by round 8, which closes on **9 May 2027**.
- You need a start other than September 2027.

## Sources

Checked on 3 November 2026:

- [Full-time MBA, Alliance Manchester Business School](https://www.alliancembs.manchester.ac.uk/study/mba/full-time-mba/): length, start, modules and careers.
- [Entry requirements](https://www.alliancembs.manchester.ac.uk/study/mba/full-time-mba/entry-requirements/) and [How to apply](https://www.alliancembs.manchester.ac.uk/study/mba/full-time-mba/how-to-apply/): tests, English, rounds, portal and fees.
- [Fees and funding](https://www.alliancembs.manchester.ac.uk/study/mba/full-time-mba/fees-funding/): tuition, Bee scholarships and alumni discount.
- [MBA course listing](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/masters/courses/list/01039/mba-manchester-full-time-mba/) and [Tuition fee deposits](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/masters/fees-and-funding/international-student-fees/tuition-fee-deposits/): documents and the deposit rule.
- [Immigration Health Surcharge](https://www.gov.uk/healthcare-immigration-application/how-much-pay): £776 a year.

Checked on 1 November 2026:

- [Student visa](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa), [Money you must show](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa/money) and [Financial evidence](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/financial-evidence-for-student-and-child-student-route-applicants): fee, 28-day rule and monthly amount.
- [Graduate visa](https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa) and [Graduate visa costs](https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa/how-much-it-costs): the 2-year and 18-month rules and the £937 fee.

Fees and rules change. Always confirm on the university's own website before you pay or apply.

faq_json.q: How much does the Full-time MBA at Manchester cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Tuition is £51,500 for the whole programme, whether you take 15 or 18 months. Add visa money, the £558 visa fee and the health surcharge. The first-year total is at least £63,373. The cost section shows the working.

faq_json.q: Do I need GMAT or GRE for the Manchester MBA?
faq_json.a: You need one of three tests: MAT (Manchester Admissions Test), GMAT or GRE.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score do I need for the Manchester MBA?
faq_json.a: You need an overall IELTS score of 6.5. You also need at least 6.5 in speaking and writing, and at least 6.0 in reading and listening.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for the Manchester MBA?
faq_json.a: Rounds run from 1 December 2026 to 9 May 2027 for applicants who need a UK visa. The first two rounds have closed. Apply early, because you can apply for a visa up to 6 months before the course starts.

faq_json.q: Is there an application fee for the Manchester Full-time MBA?
faq_json.a: No. The programme has no application fee. You do pay a deposit of at least £2,500 before your CAS is issued. This is a general postgraduate rule that does not name the MBA.
